title: letter to my kids to open in 20 years, help me write it

messages.content: starting a letter 4 my kids 2 open in 20 yrs, need help makin it good
Of course, I'd be happy to help. What message do you want to convey to them? Do you have any initial thoughts or themes in mind?
okay initial theme: Mars is the best backyard playset ever!!
That's a fun angle to start with! It captures the excitement and potential of Mars. How do you want to expand on that idea?
tell them why i was so busy, missing bday parties and all

Perhaps you could explain that your work on SpaceY and the journey to Mars was driven by a desire to create a new frontier for humanity, including them. You wanted to build a future where they could explore and thrive.
yeah exactly! add something about bldg a legacy, not just rockets
You could mention how you aimed to create a lasting impact that they, and future generations, could be proud of. It was about shaping a world where innovation and exploration were boundless.
btw mention the Cyberwedge as a reminder of fun times, even tho it kept breaking down
You might share a memory of the adventures and misadventures with the Cyberwedge, highlighting how even the challenges brought laughter and learning. Emphasize the joy of shared experiences.
what about explaining why i wanted to live on Mars so badly?
You could talk about the allure of the unknown, the drive to push boundaries, and the dream of pioneering a new way of life. Describe how Mars represented a vision of possibility and progress.
imagine them reading this on their own Martian colony, that’s the dream!
Absolutely! You might express your hope that they continue to dream big and explore uncharted territories, just as you did. Encourage them to build their own adventures on Mars and beyond.
add a joke but make it hr-safe
Sure, how about this: "Remember, by the time you read this, there will be two types of people in the world—those living on Mars and those wishing they did!"
hmm delete the joke, keep it serious this time
Understood. We can keep it heartfelt and sincere. Is there anything else you’d like to include to capture what you find most important?
something about being proud of them for whatever path they choose
You could express that your pride in them comes from their courage and curiosity, no matter where life takes them. It's about their character, not their coordinates.
perfect! wrap it up with love and hopes for the future
You might conclude with a message of love and a wish that their journeys are filled with discovery and joy. Let them know that your greatest hope is for their happiness and fulfillment.
thanks, this is going to mean a lot in the future. one rocket emoji for me.
It's an honor to help craft something so meaningful. Remember, this letter is a gift to them, a piece of your legacy. I'm sure they'll cherish it.
